name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.26: per-basket scale controls in the fridge planogram. Tap a basket and the editor now carries read weight, tare and calibrate for that basket alone; until now the dashboard could only tare a whole machine at once. Backend needed no change - scale_read, scale_tare and scale_calibrate were already validated command types, and the app answers them as prose in result.detail, which handleCommandResult already stores. That prose is rendered VERBATIM and never parsed: the fridge kiosk team asked us not to, and a regex over their wording would break silently the first time they rephrase it. Only cmd.status is keyed off. Recorded in the source where it matters: params.basket is the planogram number 1-16 within a cabinet, never a bus address - the app maps it, and asking which it was is what surfaced a mis-mapping in the kiosk app where a tare aimed at cabinet B basket 5 would have zeroed B1 and mis-charged every later sale from it (fixed their side in 0.53.1 / versionCode 134, which this UI needs on the machine or every button answers unsupported). Force-tare is offered only after the machine has refused and reported the weight it can still feel, never up front. Cumulative over v6.25.1.
